pages.title: Alchemy Station
pages.text: At the $(l)Alchemy Station$() you choose the effect in each slot of your potion. It's free.$(br2)The same effect can't go in two slots.

pages.title: Basic Effects
pages.text: $(br)Unlocked by your level:$(br)$(li)$(l)Mana Surge$(): mana$(li)$(l)Quickening$(): faster cooldowns$(li)$(l)Cleanse$(): removes negative effects$(li)$(l)Splash$(): heals your party

pages.title: Alchemy Archive
pages.text: $(l)Draughts$() are found in Alchemy Archives inside $(l:the_vault/layout#dungeons)$(t:Dungeons)dungeons$(). Your first find rolls 10-20%, then every archive offers a few points more than your best, and now and then a glowing Special roll that jumps much higher. Your best roll counts on every potion you own.

pages.title: Draughts
pages.text: $(br)Draughts last 8 seconds after a drink:$(br)$(li)$(l)Attack Damage$()$(li)$(l)Ability Power$()$(li)$(l)Movement Speed$()$(li)$(l)Armor$()$(li)$(l)Area of Effect$() up to its cap$(li)$(l)Lucky Hit$() up to its cap$(li)$(l)Spellbrew$(): your next cast is free and hits harder$(br2)Drinking again restarts them, they never stack.
